## Add or update a project

**Project name and URL:**

**Category:**

### Checklist

- [ ] I added or edited the entry in `data/entries.json` (not the README tables directly).
- [ ] The entry is placed alphabetically by name within its category.
- [ ] The description is one factual sentence, 160 characters or fewer, with no em-dash or en-dash.
- [ ] The project is tooling (SDK, framework, server, skill, wallet, data or infrastructure), not an individual token or coin.
- [ ] The URL resolves and the project works with, or targets, Solana.
- [ ] I ran `npm run validate` and `npm run build` and committed the regenerated README.
